items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-30
items.q: No I always talk to him but I didn't know him.

ctx.x: Well I had no one little fella used to call Shorty. No short fella. Used to know him. I had another one used to call. Used to call Papa Lewis if he's dead. And them old fella. They gone now.
What about Nicodemus? Did you ever know a fella named Nicodemus?
No I always talk to him but I didn't know him.
